# Ritik Soni — Creative Director, Video Production Executive & Post Lead

> Ritik Soni is an Indian Commercial Film Director, Video Production Executive, Lead Video Editor, and Social Media Manager specializing in high-retention short-form reels, flagship brand commercials, and documentary storytelling. Over 50M+ cumulative organic impressions generated for global enterprise clients including Red Bull, Reliance Industries, AdenTech, and Vishwa Vinayak Group.
